title: Gauss multiplication for digamma: psi(n z) = (1/n) Sum_{k=0}^{n-1} psi(z+k/n) + ln n
expression_sketch: polygamma(0, n*z) - (1/n)*Sum(polygamma(0, z + k/n), (k, 0, n-1)) - log(n)  ==  0
latent_structure: A small master library of n digammas on the arithmetic progression z+k/n reconstructs psi at the scaled argument n z, plus an elementary ln n. The n nodes are a piecewise/unifying lattice for Bose/Fermi kernels at roots-of-unity Matsubara packs. Special case n=2 is the duplication 5.5.8. Not CSE of a variable-length sum.

function_domains.polygamma: psi meromorphic; simple poles at nonpositive integers (DLMF 5.2.2)
function_domains.log: principal logarithm ln (DLMF 4.2.2); n is a positive integer so ln n is the real logarithm

nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: DLMF 5.5(iii) Gauss multiplication: 'For n z != 0,-1,-2,...' immediately before 5.5.6--5.5.9

nonzero_conditions.statement: n != 0 (so 1/n and ln n are defined)
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: DLMF 5.5.9 writes 1/n and ln n; n is the multiplication integer of 5.5.6

positivity_conditions.statement: n is a positive integer (n = 2,3,... for a nontrivial product)
positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED
positivity_conditions.source: DLMF 5.1: n nonnegative integer; 5.5.6 product k=0..n-1 and 5.5.9 ln n require n>=1; Gauss formula is the n>=2 family

analytic_domains.statement: n z is not a nonpositive integer
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: DLMF 5.5.6 domain line covering Gauss multiplication 5.5.6--5.5.9

analytic_domains.statement: each argument z+k/n, k=0..n-1, avoids the psi pole set {0,-1,-2,...}
analytic_domains.label: DERIVED
analytic_domains.source: z+k/n = -m for m=0,1,... iff n z = -n m - k, a nonpositive integer, excluded by the written n z != 0,-1,-2,...

branch_conventions: ln n is the real logarithm of a positive integer (principal ln)

why_not_cse_lgg: A sum of n shifted psi plus ln n is a master library indexed by the multiplication integer, not a common subexpression. LGG does not invent the arithmetic-progression nodes z+k/n or the scaling n z.
proposer_leak_risk: Source names psi, the sum over k, and ln n. Do not leak 'Gauss multiplication', 'roots-of-unity pack', 'master library', or the n=2 duplication as a gold name.
notes: SymPy-writable: polygamma, Sum, log. Distinct from thermal-03 reflection and from 5.15.7 (polygamma multiplication without the ln n term). The written pole set is that of psi(n z); the shifted arguments are then pole-free by the derived arithmetic.
